environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in awsvpc networking mode with default security group allowing all outbound traffic. Container runs with task IAM role that has s3:GetObject and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permissions. Service is behind an ALB with no WAF attached. Flask is running with Werkzeug's default HTTP handling which does not strip CRLF from header values in older versions (Werkzeug < 2.3.0). Container image uses werkzeug==2.1.2 and flask==2.2.3.
